title: 第1章 她快死在床上了
novel_title: 贵族学院平民盲女怎么成了白月光
content_zh:
安怜觉得自己要死了。

    不是夸张，是真的要死在床上了。

    江彻的掌心滚烫，贴在她腰间，像烙铁一样。

    她想躲，可男人手臂箍得太紧，她被他圈在怀里，后背抵着柔软的床铺，连呼吸都变得稀薄。

    “阿彻……”她柔柔地唤她，尾音发颤，像小猫被踩了尾巴。

    江彻没应声，鼻尖蹭过她耳廓，灼热的气息落在她的耳垂上。

    安怜下意识缩了缩脖子，手指攥紧他肩头的衬衫，将那一小块布料揉得皱巴巴的。

    “躲什么？”江彻开口，嗓音低低沉沉的，像含着一口没化开的蜜，又黏又哑，从喉咙深处碾出来。

    “……明天还要上课。”安怜声音里带着明显的求饶意味。

    “嗯。”江彻应了一声，却没有停下来的意思。

    吻落在颈侧，留下一片湿意。

    安怜咬咬唇，声音软得能滴出水来：“江彻，你听到没有呀？”

    江彻闻言，抬起头。

    他撑在她上方，逆着光，轮廓深邃。

    他的眉骨高，眼尾上挑，是那种一看就不好惹的长相。

    此刻那双沉稳又带着几分掌控欲的眼睛微微眯着，目光落在安怜泛红的脸颊上，喉结滚动。

    “听到什么？”他问。

    安怜：？

    她气得想踹他，但腿被他压着根本动不了，只能伸手去推他的胸膛。

    可惜她的力气在江彻面前跟挠痒痒似的。

    “我说明天还要上课，”安怜又重复了一遍，撒娇道：“你让我早点睡好不好？”

    江彻盯着她看了两秒，低头在她红唇上啄了一口，理直气壮：“不好。”

    安怜：“……”

    她就知道。

    江彻这个人，平时在外面端着副沉稳矜贵的模样。

    什么投资大亨、商业天才，所有人都说他冷静自持、喜怒不形于色。

    可只有安怜知道，这人私底下有多恶劣。

    尤其是这种时候。
content_en:
An Lian felt like she was going to die.

    It's not an exaggeration, I really want to die in bed.

    Jiang Che's palms were hot and pressed against her waist, like a soldering iron.

    She wanted to hide, but the man's arms were too tight. She was trapped in his arms, her back pressed against the soft bed, and even her breathing became thin.

    "Archer..." She called her softly, her voice trembling like a kitten's tail being stepped on.

    Jiang Che didn't respond, the tip of his nose brushed against the shell of her ear, and his hot breath fell on her earlobe.

    An Lian subconsciously shrank her neck, her fingers clenched the shirt on his shoulders, and crumpled the small piece of fabric.

    "What are you hiding from?" Jiang Che spoke, his voice low and deep, like a mouthful of unmelted honey, sticky and hoarse, coming out from deep in his throat.

    "...We still have classes tomorrow." An Lian's voice contained an obvious hint of begging for mercy.

    "Yeah." Jiang Che responded, but had no intention of stopping.

    The kiss fell on the side of the neck, leaving a wet feeling.

    An Lian bit her lip and her voice was so soft it could drip water: "Jiang Che, did you hear that?"

    Jiang Che raised his head after hearing this.

    He stood above her, against the light, his outline was deep.

    His eyebrows are high and the ends of his eyes are raised. He has the kind of appearance that is not easy to mess with at first sight.

    At this moment, those steady and somewhat controlling eyes were slightly narrowed, and their eyes fell on An Lian's red cheeks, and her Adam's apple rolled.

    "What did you hear?" he asked.

    An Lian:?

    She was so angry that she wanted to kick him, but her legs were pressed by him and she couldn't move at all, so she could only reach out and push his chest.

    It's a pity that her strength is like scratching an itch in front of Jiang Che.

    "I said I have to go to class tomorrow," An Lian repeated, coquettishly: "Can you tell me to go to bed early?"

    Jiang Che stared at her for two seconds, then lowered his head and pecked her red lips, and said confidently, "Not good."

    An Lian: "..."

    She knew it.

    Jiang Che usually looks calm and dignified outside.

    He is an investment tycoon and a business genius. Everyone says that he is calm and self-possessed, and that he does not express emotions or anger.

    But only An Lian knew how bad this person was in private.

    Especially at times like this.
title_en: Chapter 1 She is dying in bed
